comments.content: The draft of Vault.ist API reference https://choisecom.notion.site/Vault-API-Specification-4d2719b90070482bb788115beded1be5

I think that it is necessary to first get a more correct offer from Vault.ist which reflects the use of the API, and then make a decision on choosing one of these two providers.
Based on my personal observations, both providers Paymentology and Vault.ist are quite slow.
I continue to look for new providers that could become a strong strategic partner.

During the recent days, I had an extensive conversation with Vault ist.
They will add details regarding their API to the updated offer for us. 
Also, they will be able to consult us on fee structure to earn on users' card transactions.
After these negotiations, I do not think that they will reduce their prices for us.
The goal of this issue is to receive at least 1 official offer from any of these 2 card issuance providers.
We have already got an offer from Paymentology and will get a relevant offer from Vault ist. 
@pavlovcik I suggest closing this issue as done. 
For the next steps, new issues should be created.

### Intro 
At the moment, I am negotiating with 2 card issuance providers which provide global card issuance services.
Paymentology
https://www.paymentology.com/platform/prepaid-and-debit-cards
https://www.paymentology.com/product/flex
https://www.paymentology.com/use-cases/digital-banks
https://www.paymentology.com/use-cases/high-performing-fintechs
Choise 
https://choise.com/card
https://vault.ist/ 
They are satisfied that Ubiquity 
- A crypto company
- Registered in the BVI
Identified risks
- Providers may not be satisfied with the small number of cards that Ubiquity needs at the beginning 
- Providers prices may be higher than our expectations
I expect to receive an offer from at least one of these 2 providers in October 2023.
Other providers are covered in separate tasks so an offer from another provider from these 2 will not be considered as a deliverable for this task.
@pavlovcik You [recommended](https://github.com/ubiquity/card-issuance/issues/6#issuecomment-1725186490) batching several bounties into one because it can be more efficient for approvals from you.
Please, review this bounty that combines negotiation with these 2 providers. 
### Goal 
Receive at least 1 official offer from any of these 2 card issuance providers
### Activity 
- Clarify our and their requirements
- Prepare for calls and read their documentation 
- Make calls with them
- Provide answers to the providers' questions
- Sign an NDA (with Choise)
And so on
### Time estimate 
It is extremely difficult to determine how much pure time it will take before receiving an offer.
At the moment I estimate the pure time spent for 1 provider at least 1 week.
2 providers mean a minimum of 2 weeks.
